result.topic_en: Riemann's integral representations, along characteristics in the variables p, q, of the derivatives of a function w and of x − (p+q±½)at, used in his treatment of finite-amplitude air waves, together with a note on the integrability condition ∂P/∂q = ∂Q/∂p for P dp + Q dq.
result.transcription:
$\left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial p}\right)_{p',q'} = \left(v\frac{\partial w}{\partial p}\right)_{p',q} + \int_{q',q}^{p',q'} \left(\left(v - \frac{\partial v}{\partial p}\right)\frac{\partial w}{\partial p}dp + v\frac{\partial w}{\partial q}dq\right)$
$\left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial q}\right)_{p',q'} = \left(v\frac{\partial w}{\partial q}\right)_{q',q} + \int_{q',q}^{p',q'} v\frac{\partial w}{\partial p}dp + \frac{\partial w}{\partial q}dq\left(v + \frac{\partial v}{\partial q}\right)$ $t=0$:
